notes.title: The Elephant Collection - Out Now!
notes.content:
Hi ravers, if you loved Elephant Rave 2 you'll 100% love The Elephant Collection, a collection of ten fully-remastered elephant games (including the original Elephant Rave!). You can find it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2274110/The_Elephant_Collection/

The games included are:

This is the Only Level 1, 2, and 3
Achievement Unlocked 1, 2, and 3
Obey! The Game
Elephant Rave
Run Elephant Run
Elephant Quest

Some of these games are among the most popular games ever released on web, now beautifully restored for PC/Mac platforms.

We also built this crazy hub world full of nods to the original games, behind-the-scenes commentary on each game and how they were made, and 30 new achievements to get you exploring!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44593478/edeb31593913c565eec717de055505171eb90525.jpg[/img]

Sorry for the buzz marketing, hope you enjoyed Elephant Rave 2 and see you... maybe... in Elephant Rave 3? Maybe?
